description_en: Queries one or more SAP HANA backups that meet the specified conditions
description_zh: 查询一个或多个符合条件的SAP HANA备份
name: DescribeHanaBackupsAsync

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 99. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The recovery mode. Valid values:
RECOVERY_TO_MOST_RECENT: Most recent time. Restores the database to the most recent available state from backups.
RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME: Point in time. Restores the database to a specific point in time.
RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP: Specific backup. Restores the database to a specified database backup.
RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION: Log position. Restores the database to a specified log position
parameters.help_zh:
恢复方式。
RECOVERY_TO_MOST_RECENT： 最近时间，将数据库恢复到已备份的最近可用状态。
RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME：指定时间，将数据库恢复到特定时间点。
RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP：指定备份，将数据库恢复到指定的数据库备份。
RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION：日志位置，将数据库还原到指定日志位置
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore the database. This parameter is valid only when the Mode parameter is set to RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME. The system restores the database to the state closest to this point in time
parameters.help_zh: 选择需要恢复到的时间点。仅选择RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME恢复方式时有效，系统会将数据库恢复到离这个时间最近的状态
parameters.name: recovery_point_in_time

parameters.help_en: The log position. This parameter is valid only when the Mode parameter is set to RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION
parameters.help_zh: 日志位置，仅选择RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION恢复方式时有效
parameters.name: log_position

parameters.help_en: The ID of the volume to restore. This parameter is valid only when the Mode parameter is set to RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION
parameters.help_zh: 要恢复的Volume ID。仅选择RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION恢复方式时有效
parameters.name: volume_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform cross-instance recovery. Valid values:
true: Performs cross-instance recovery.
false: Does not perform cross-instance recovery
parameters.help_zh:
是否是跨实例恢复。

true：跨实例恢复
false：非跨实例恢复
parameters.name: system_copy

parameters.help_en: The name of the source system. This parameter specifies the name of the source database to restore. Format: `Source database name@SID`
parameters.help_zh: 源系统名。表示需要恢复的源数据库名，格式为`源数据库名@SID`
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The source SAP HANA instance ID
parameters.name: source_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include differential backups. Valid values:
true: Includes differential backups.
false: Does not include differential backups
parameters.help_zh:
是否包括差异备份。
true：包括差异备份
false：不包括差异备份
parameters.name: include_differential

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include incremental backups. Valid values:
true: Includes incremental backups.
false: Does not include incremental backups
parameters.help_zh:
是否包括增量备份。
true：包括增量备份
false：不包括增量备份
parameters.name: include_incremental

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include log backups. Valid values:
true: Includes log backups.
false: Does not include log backups
parameters.help_zh:
是否包括日志备份。
true：包括日志备份
false：不包括日志备份
parameters.name: include_log

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use Backint. Valid values:
true: Uses Backint.
false: Does not use Backint
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用Backint。
true：使用Backint
false：不使用Backint
parameters.name: use_backint

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

Message.description_en: The return message. The value successful is returned for successful requests, and a specific error message is returned for failed requests
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task. You can call the DescribeTask operation to obtain the task result
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID。可以通过调用DescribeTask获取任务结果
